detail.longDescription: My name is Aleksei Babkin, I am CEO and CTO of Aisma Video Editor project. Main feature of Aisma is understanding of simple user request about editing of his video, and explain to generation model what exactly need to change, skipping parts where no need to change anything, decreasing the price of editing. Aisma can work in any browsers, native iOS and Android apps, also API, MCP connection are available for comfortable work using AI agents and also our new goal is native ChatGPT plugin was reached, available in all markets where plugins in ChatGPT are available. Main idea, as I told before, was to minimize price of editing by preview of video and apply each part of prompt to the part of video where it should to be edited, and even if some part was edited not perfectly, you will have an opportunity to add details and edit only this part of your video, which can be x10 times cheaper than new try to edit all video again and finally get issue in other part of result... Now we support video from 2 to 60 seconds, but going to increase maximal length to 180 sec already at the beginning of 2027 All new users have a free credits which are enough for 10 sec video editing, but this is temporary promo, because as everyone knows this promo will be abused by many not polite users. If you have any questions I will be here next several hours, also you can always reach me by email ceo@aisma.ai
